# Green Attic

> > Green Attic is Chicago's premier certified insulation contractor offering residential, commercial, and industrial insulation solutions with 15+ years of expertise and comprehensive energy efficiency services.

Green Attic has been serving the Chicago and suburban area since 2009, specializing in attic insulation, spray foam, cellulose insulation, air sealing, and ventilation systems. The company is known for certified installations, competitive rebate programs, and strong customer satisfaction with extensive warranties.
